Wickets in quick succession and SA are three down now, but still have a healthy lead!

OverHistory.Commentry: Ravindra Jadeja bowling to Tony De Zorzi, full length ball, pitching on off stump, Tony De Zorzi plays a sweep shot WICKET Tony De Zorzi lbw Ravindra Jadeja (South Africa 178 Runs for 4 wickets), Appeal from the fielding side
OverHistory.UPDCommentry:
NUMBER THREE FOR JADEJA! Ravindra Jadeja bowling to Tony De Zorzi, full length ball, pitching on off stump, Tony De Zorzi gets low onto sweep, he misses this completely as he plays for turn. Still, the ball straightens after pitching, gets him trapped in front and too easy for the umpire to raise his finger! They decide to review, but the replay shows three reds, and Jadeja strikes again! What is more interesting here is- this is the first LBW dismissal this game! 

WICKET Tony De Zorzi lbw Ravindra Jadeja (South Africa 178 Runs for 4 wickets)

Senuran Muthusamy bowling to Ravindra Jadeja, full toss ball, outside off stump, Ravindra Jadeja picks the full toss as it was flighted way above his eye sight.
